metric_spec.right_answer_ids: per query, set of canonical 'right' doc ids (size 1 for most, size>1 when multiple docs equally relevant)
metric_spec.hit_at_N: true iff at least one right_answer_id appears in /search top-N. min_rank is the lowest rank of any right answer in the result set.
metric_spec.exclude_from_winrate: true when the query premise is broken (e.g. wrong name, ambiguous intent) so no ranking signal is meaningful
